India and Indonesia Sign Agreements, Establish Overseas IIM Campus

During Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Indonesia, India and Indonesia signed several agreements, including pacts on health and education. A key announcement was the establishment of the first overseas campus for IIM Bangalore in East Java, Indonesia, which will offer executive programs. The visit also saw discussions on artificial intelligence, space, and startups, and included a parliamentary address by PM Modi.
